answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on asynchronous consensus epochs backed by multi-party quorum signatures. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. A tundra of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nebula of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The meadow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
